name: @cerbos/orm-prisma
description: Prisma adapter for Cerbos query plans
author: Cerbos <help@cerbos.dev> (https://cerbos.dev)
//test: `test` is the translator unit test: offline, so no Cerbos sidecar, no `db push`, and no generated client. It is also engine-agnostic — it produces where-inputs and never hands one to a Prisma client — which is why it has no v6/v7 split. Only `test:adversarial*` needs a PDP and a store.

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:v7 && npm run typecheck:v6
scripts.test:adversarial:v6: npm run prisma:generate:v6 && node node_modules/prisma-v6/build/index.js db push --force-reset --skip-generate --schema=prisma/schema.adversarial.v6.prisma && PRISMA_VERSION=6 cerbos run --log-level=error --set=storage.disk.directory=../conformance/policies --set=telemetry.disabled=true -- jest --config jest.adversarial.config.js
scripts.test:adversarial:v7: npm run prisma:generate:v7 && node node_modules/prisma/build/index.js db push --force-reset --schema=prisma/schema.adversarial.prisma --url=file:./prisma/dev-adversarial.db && PRISMA_VERSION=7 cerbos run --log-level=error --set=storage.disk.directory=../conformance/policies --set=telemetry.disabled=true -- jest --config jest.adversarial.config.js
scripts.test:adversarial:postgres:v6: npm run prisma:generate:v6 && ADAPTER_TEST_DB=postgres PRISMA_VERSION=6 cerbos run --log-level=error --set=storage.disk.directory=../conformance/policies --set=telemetry.disabled=true -- jest --config jest.adversarial.config.js
scripts.test:adversarial:postgres:v7: npm run prisma:generate:v7 && ADAPTER_TEST_DB=postgres PRISMA_VERSION=7 cerbos run --log-level=error --set=storage.disk.directory=../conformance/policies --set=telemetry.disabled=true -- jest --config jest.adversarial.config.js
